dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, continuous 2D narrowing of the body mass from the mid-dorsal region to the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light blue-grey skin tone consistent with a sub-adult or near-mature individual, with high-intensity specular highlights along the dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed irregularly across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-contrast gradient between the primary light-grey baseline and localized darker pigmented patches.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dorsal ridge featuring a series of high-contrast, point-source specular highlights along the central longitudinal axis.
